what: A switch rehearsal used a day-old data copy and did not prove current data compatibility.
Demo screenshots with fake data were accepted as UI proof; a person later found a transparent dropdown.
A silence watchdog killed a long suite; status stayed active and the report blamed an unrelated earlier error.
A watcher tracked the launcher instead of the real worker and announced a false finish.
The app only quit through its tray menu, leaving an automated switch dependent on a human click.
Synthetic recurrence: the next switch rehearsal again used an old copy.
